verdict.rationale: Hummingbird is a compliance case-management SaaS, so self-hosting is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions on-premises deployment, self-hosting, or downloadable or open-source distribution. The docs describe only hosted APIs, in-app features and account configuration done by Hummingbird.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
